descFull: Lightweight self-hosted NVR in Go — single static binary, zero dependencies, embedded web UI. RTSP/ONVIF/Xiaomi/GB28181/WHIP cameras, RTMP/SRT push-in, WebRTC/HLS/FLV live view, audio, timelapse, continuous playback, S3 offload, browser-side AI detection. Runs on low-power ARM.
